2B. FLEX LAMINATE WITH COPPER CLADDING: IPC-4204/11

3A. FABRICATE IN ACCORDANCE WITH IPC-6013 AND SPACE ADDENDUM, CLASS 3 UNLESS

4. DIMENSIONS:
4A. THE NOMINAL DIAMETERS SPECIFIED FOR PLATED HOLES APPLY AFTER PLATING
4B. DIMENSIONS APPLY WHEN DATUM [-A-] IS RESTRAINED FLAT WITHIN 0.127 MM
5B. VIAS SHALL BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH IPC-4761 TYPE VII (FILLED AND CAPPED)
6. BOARD LAYERS:
6A. OVERALL BOARD THICKNESS SHALL BE +/- 10%
7. SURFACE FINISH:
7A. FINAL FINISH: ALL EXPOSED CONDUCTOR SURFACES WILL BE TYPE ENIG IN ACCORDANCE
7B. SOLDERABILITY TESTING WILL BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH IPC-J-STD-003, CATEGORY 2 CLASS 3
8. SOLDERMASK:
8A. SOLDERMASK OVER BARE COPPER IN ACCORDANCE WITH IPC-SM-840, CLASS H
8B. MASK TYYPE: LPI
8C. MASK COLOR: GREEN
8D. SOLDERMASK ADJUSTMENT ALLOWED WITH A MAXIMUM SPREAD/INCREASE OF 0.1 MM
(0.05 MM EXPANSION PER SIDE)
8E. GANG MASK OF IC PATTERNS ALLOWED WHERE SOLDERMASK WEB IS LESS THEN OR EQUAL TO
0.1 MM, PROVIDED NO TRACES ARE EXPOSED
9. LEGEND:
9A. SHALL BE IN ACCORDANCE WITH IPC-4781, TYPE 2
9B. LEGEND TYPE: NON-CONDUCTIVE EPOXY INK
9C. COLOR: WHITE
9D. LEGEND SHALL BE TRIMMED FROM ANY EXPOSED CONDUCTORS TO A MAXIMUM CLIPBACK OF 0.08 MM
10. CAM FILES:
10A. VENDOR MAY ADD NON-FUNCTIONAL PADS FOR DRILLING. NO METAL OF THE
NON-FUNCTIONAL PAD TO REMAIN AFTER FINAL DRILLING.
10B. VENDOR MAY ADD THIEVING. THIEVING SHAPES MUST BE NO GREATER THAN 0.3 CM^2
IN SURFACE AREA AND A MINIMUM OF 2.54 MM FROM ALL DESIGN ENTITIES
10C. BLUE ORIGIN SHALL APPROVE EDITED CAM FILES (1-UP) PRIOR TO START OF FABRICATION
NO FURTHER MODIFICATION ALLOWED AFTER APPROVAL.
11. TESTING:
11A. PCB SHALL BE ELECTRICALLY TESTED TO CAD NETLIST PROVIDED IN ACCORDANCE WITH IPC-9252
12. IMPEDANCE CONTROLLED TRACES:
12A. PCB HAS IMPEDANCE CONTROLLED TRACES. REFER TO IMPEDANCE TABLE.
13. VENDOR MARKINGS:
13A. VENDOR SHALL MARK BOARDS WITH DATE CODE IN YY-WW OR YYWW FORMAT.
MARKING INK SHALL BE INACCORDANCE WITH IPC-4781 TYPE 2
13B. LOCATE VENDOR MARKINGS AND DATE CODE ON SECONDARY SIDE SILKSCREEN ONLY,
FREE FROM ANY METAL ENTITY
13C. VENDOR MARKING SHALL INCLUDE ANY ADDITIONAL INFORMATION REQUIRED
TO IDENTIFY THE MANUFACTURED PCB THROUGHOUT ALL PROCESSES.
